description: The old code compared unhandled string types (TeletexString, BMPString, UniversalString) by byte value only. Two different string types with identical byte sequences would have compared equal, violating RFC 4518 which defines normalization per encoding type. The new code checks tag == tag && value == value, disambiguating encodings. This is a correctness fix for a latent vulnerability: a certificate with TeletexString(0xABCD) would have matched BMPString(0xABCD) under the old code but must not (different encodings). No known real-world impact (collision would require identical bytes in two different encodings), but semantically correct.
title: TeletexString/BMPString tag check closes encoding collision vulnerability
